dependencies: Python 3.10+ standard library and the system patch command for actual correction replay.
historic_text: Pending-review and no-publication language inside frozen files records earlier stages, not the present acceptance of this scoped partial.
linear_obstruction_scope: epsilon=0 only; no counterexample to the positive-epsilon target
oldform_scope: c Delta(Nz), every N>=1, every positive epsilon; not arbitrary oldform mixtures or the whole cusp space
remaining_gap: Uniform quantitative least-Gram-eigenvalue or equivalent horostrip lower bound for all forms at all levels.
